purpose: Move list and Controls concepts matching title/pause/settings; not integrated into the game

prompts.name: movelist
prompts.prompt:
Stylised toon-shaded game art, flat cel colour in 2-3 tone steps, clean confident ink-brush outline of even weight, muted ukiyo-e colour palette, matte surfaces, soft even lighting with no cast shadows, no photographic or painterly texture, no gloss, no baked ambient occlusion, simple readable shapes.
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished 16:9 full-screen PC game menu concept for Yokai Fighters, a Japanese folklore roguelite fighting game. Full bleed screen, no device frame, no collage. Palette: indigo #2D3A5E, ink #1D1B21, rice paper #F1E8D4, pine #34483B, shrine red #B5332B, persimmon #D8632C. Refined bold editorial layout, generous negative space, extremely legible English UI typography, expressive brush lettering only for major headings. Restrained flat paper shapes and ink separators; no excessive distressed noise. No real kanji, no watermark, no unrelated logos, no photorealism, no glossy UI, no neon.
Match the existing Settings concept exactly: wide centered torn-edge rice-paper sheet over the same indigo and pine night-bamboo backdrop with pale moon, mountain and red torii, small flat white fox mask motif with red markings at the sheet's upper right corner, brush-lettered heading with an ink rule beneath it, bold serif body text, red underline on the selected tab, red brush-stroke selection highlight. Move list screen. Heading 'MOVE LIST'. Subtitle 'Ryo's kit. Kihon: Special + direction, 100% damage.' Top right two small outlined buttons 'Inputs: Kihon' and 'Frame data: off'. Left two-thirds, section 'BASE KIT' as a clean three-column table (move name in pine, input in ink, short plain description): Walk | Hold back / forward | Step toward or away from the foe.; Dash | Double-tap back / forward | A quick hop forward or back.; Jump | Up, up-forward, up-back | Leap over attacks, or dive in with an air attack.; Block | Hold back (crouch: lows) | Hold back to block. Crouch to block low hits.; Light punch | LP | Quick jab. Starts combos.; Heavy kick | HK | Wide sweeping kick. Slow, but it hits hard.; Throw | LP + LK | Grabs a guarding foe.; Burst | LP + MP + HP while hit | Break a combo for all your meter.; thin ink rules between groups. Right third, section 'SPECIALS' with four compact talisman strips like the Pause concept, each with a coloured diamond badge and three small level pips: 'A Spirit Wave', 'Kihon: Special + neutral', 'Throw a wave of spirit ink across the screen.' Lv 1; 'B Rising Talisman', 'Kihon: Special + forward', 'A rising talisman strike that beats jumps.' Lv 2; 'C Foxfire', 'Kihon: Special + back', 'Launch a slow fox flame that drifts across the screen.' Lv 1; 'D' greyed out, 'Slot D: empty', 'Win a duel and draft a power from the yokai you bind.' Footer key chips 'ESC  Back', 'TAB  Frame data', 'Q  Switch Kata / Kihon'. Extremely clean, carefully aligned, professionally typeset.
